title: Default insight list ordering must use indexed columns with tiebreakers
answers: Why does listing insights without an order parameter time out or run slowly?
How to order insight list querysets when no order param is provided?
Why does InsightViewSet default order to -last_modified_at and -pk?
What index covers default ordering for the insights list endpoint?
body:
Symptom: API requests listing insights without an `order` parameter wait tens of seconds per page or time out, pinning web workers.
Root cause: products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/insight.py:InsightViewSet defaulted unordered listings to `order_by("order")`, an unindexed nullable column causing full project table scans and sorts on Postgres.
Fix pattern: Default unordered list queries to sort by an indexed column with a deterministic tiebreaker (`order_by("-last_modified_at", "-pk")`) supported by partial index `dashboarditem_team_lmod_idx`.
Constraints: Applies to insight list requests where `order` and `search` query parameters are not provided; explicit order parameters and search queries follow their own ordering.
applies: Default queryset ordering and pagination in products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/insight.py:InsightViewSet
